meta.label: Query Generic Microsoft Graph API
meta.description: Generic connector to query any Microsoft Graph API endpoint (v1.0 or beta). Supports flexible parameters including HTTP method, OData query parameters, custom headers, and request body for POST/PATCH operations.

params.name: api_version
params.label: API Version
params.description: Microsoft Graph API version to use

params.name: api_endpoint
params.label: API Endpoint
params.description: API endpoint path (e.g., /users, /groups/{id}/members, /me/drive/root/children). Do not include the base URL or API version.

params.name: http_method
params.label: HTTP Method
params.description: HTTP method for the API request

params.name: query_select
params.label: $select - Select Fields
params.description: OData $select parameter: comma-separated list of fields to include (e.g., 'id,displayName,mail')

params.name: query_filter
params.label: $filter - Filter Expression
params.description: OData $filter parameter: filter condition (e.g., "startswith(displayName, 'John')" or "accountEnabled eq true")

params.name: query_top
params.label: $top - Max Records Per Request
params.description: OData $top parameter: maximum number of records to retrieve per API request (max 999)

params.name: query_search
params.label: $search - Search Term
params.description: OData $search parameter: search for text content (only works on specific endpoints that support it)

params.name: custom_headers
params.label: Custom HTTP Headers
params.description: JSON object with additional HTTP headers (e.g., {"Prefer": "outlook.timezone=UTC"})

params.name: request_body
params.label: Request Body (POST/PATCH)
params.description: JSON body for POST or PATCH requests. Leave empty for GET/DELETE requests (e.g., {"displayName": "New Name"})
